    99→  { id: "acquire",  label: "TARGET ACQUIRED", icon: Target,      accent: "white" },
   100→  { id: "fetch",    label: "FETCHING",        icon: Globe,       accent: "cyan" },
   101→  { id: "analyze",  label: "ANALYZING",       icon: ScanLine,     accent: "cyan" },
   102→  { id: "pattern",  label: "PATTERN MATCH",  icon: Cpu,          accent: "violet" },
   103→  { id: "fingerprint", label: "AI FINGERPRINT", icon: Brain,     accent: "violet" },

   106→
   107→// ============================================================================

   192→
   193→// ============================================================================
   194→// Main page component
   195→// ============================================================================
   196→export default function Home() {
   197→  const { data: session } = useSession();
   198→  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
   199→  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(false);
   200→  const [stage, setStage] = useState(0);
   201→  const [result, setResult] = useState<ScanResult | null>(null);
   202→  const [sessionHistory, setSessionHistory] = useState<ScanResult[]>([]);
   203→  const [savedScans, setSavedScans] = useState<ScanResult[]>([]);
   204→  const [loadingSaved, setLoadingSaved] = useState(false);
   205→  const [clock, setClock] = useState("");
   206→  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
   207→
   208→  // Track the latest session in a ref so callbacks/handlers that are set up
   209→  // once (on mount) can always access the current session without stale closures.
   210→  const sessionRef = useRef(session);
   211→  useEffect(() => {
   212→    sessionRef.current = session;
   213→  }, [session]);
   214→
   215→  // Live LOCAL clock (uses the viewer's own timezone)
   216→  useEffect(() => {
   217→    const tick = () => {
   218→      const d = new Date();
   219→      const hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0");
   220→      const mm = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
   221→      const ss = String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
   222→      setClock(`${hh}:${mm}:${ss}`);
   223→    };
   224→    tick();
   225→    const id = setInterval(tick, 1000);
   226→    return () => clearInterval(id);
   227→  }, []);
   228→
   229→  // -------- Smooth scroll to section + view transition --------
   230→  // Clicking a sidebar nav item triggers a brief "wipe" transition
   231→  // overlay + smooth-scrolls to the target section. The destination
   232→  // section's `whileInView` animation then fires as it enters viewport.
   233→  const [viewTransitioning, setViewTransitioning] = useState(false);
   234→  const transitionTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   235→  const scrollToSection = useCallback((id: string) => {
   236→    // Trigger the wipe overlay
   237→    setViewTransitioning(true);
   238→    if (transitionTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(transitionTimerRef.current);
   239→    // Smooth-scroll to the target
   240→    setTimeout(() => {
   241→      if (id === "#") {
   242→        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
   243→      } else {
   244→        const el = document.querySelector(id);
   245→        if (el) {
   246→          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
   247→        }
   248→      }
   249→    }, 30); // small delay so the wipe overlay starts rendering first
   250→    // Hide the wipe overlay after the transition completes
   251→    transitionTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setViewTransitioning(false), 750);
   252→  }, []);
   253→
   254→  // -------- Track active section for sidebar highlight --------
   255→  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState<string>("#");
   256→  useEffect(() => {
   257→    const sections = ["#target", "#verification", "#detection", "#report", "#history", "#profile"]
   258→      .map((id) => document.querySelector(id))
   259→      .filter(Boolean) as Element[];
   260→    if (sections.length === 0) return;
   261→    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
   262→      (entries) => {
   263→        const visible = entries
   264→          .filter((e) => e.isIntersecting)
   265→          .sort((a, b) => b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio);
   266→        if (visible.length > 0) {
   267→          const id = `#${visible[0].target.id}`;
   268→          setActiveSection(id);
   269→        }
   270→      },
   271→      { rootMargin: "-20% 0px -50% 0px", threshold: [0.1, 0.25, 0.5] }
   272→    );
   273→    sections.forEach((s) => observer.observe(s));
   274→    return () => observer.disconnect();
   275→  }, [result, sessionHistory, savedScans]);
   276→
   277→  const refreshSaved = useCallback(async () => {
   278→    // Use sessionRef.current instead of session to avoid stale closure
   279→    // (this callback is captured by the socket event handlers which are
   280→    // set up once on mount, so the session value would be null from the
   281→    // initial render if we used the closure variable directly)
   282→    if (!sessionRef.current?.user) {
   283→      setSavedScans([]);
   284→      return;
   285→    }
   286→    setLoadingSaved(true);
   287→    try {
   288→      const res = await fetch("/api/scans", { method: "GET", cache: "no-store" });
   289→      const data = await res.json();
   290→      if (data.ok) setSavedScans(data.scans);
   291→    } catch {
   292→      // ignore
   293→    } finally {
   294→      setLoadingSaved(false);
   295→    }
   296→  }, []);
   297→
   298→  useEffect(() => {
   299→    refreshSaved();
   300→  }, [refreshSaved, session]);
   301→
   302→  // -------- WebSocket connection to the scanner service (port 3030) --------
   303→  // Real-time scan progress: stage events fire as the scanner actually
   304→  // completes each step (replaces fake stage timing). Findings appear
   305→  // one-by-one as they're discovered. The scanner service has NO DB
   306→  // access — it just runs the scan and emits events. The frontend
   307→  // POSTs the final result to /api/scans/save for persistence.
   308→  const socketRef = useRef<Socket | null>(null);
   309→  // sessionRef is defined above (near the state declarations) to avoid ordering issues
   310→  const [socketConnected, setSocketConnected] = useState(false);
   311→  const liveFindingsRef = useRef<Finding[]>([]);
   312→
   313→  // Map real backend stage names → existing 6-stage UI index
   314→  const stageToIndex: Record<string, number> = {
   315→    acquire: 0,        // TARGET ACQUIRED
   316→    fetch_html: 1,     // FETCHING
   317→    analyze_html: 2,   // ANALYZING
   318→    fetch_scripts: 3,  // PATTERN MATCH
   319→    pattern_match: 3,  // PATTERN MATCH (still)
   320→    ai_fingerprint: 4, // AI FINGERPRINT
   321→    probe_paths: 4,    // AI FINGERPRINT (still)
   322→    complete: 5,       // COMPLETE
   323→  };
   324→
   325→  useEffect(() => {
   326→    // Connect to the scanner-service on port 3030 via the Caddy gateway.
   327→    // Path is "/" (required) and XTransformPort=3030 tells Caddy to forward.
   328→    // Use default transport negotiation (polling → WebSocket upgrade) for
   329→    // maximum proxy/reverse-proxy compatibility.
   330→    const socket = io("/?XTransformPort=3030", {
   331→      reconnection: true,
   332→      reconnectionAttempts: 5,
   333→      reconnectionDelay: 1000,
   334→    });
   335→    socketRef.current = socket;
   336→
   337→    socket.on("connect", () => {
   338→      setSocketConnected(true);
   339→      console.log("[scanner] connected to scanner-service");
   340→    });
   341→    socket.on("disconnect", () => {
   342→      setSocketConnected(false);
   343→      console.log("[scanner] disconnected from scanner-service");
   344→    });
   345→    socket.on("connect_error", (err: any) => {
   346→      setSocketConnected(false);
   347→      console.warn("[scanner] connect error:", err.message);
   348→    });
   349→
   350→    // Real-time stage updates from the scanner service
   351→    socket.on("scan:stage", (event: { stage: string; detail: string; findingsCount: number }) => {
   352→      const idx = stageToIndex[event.stage] ?? 0;
   353→      setStage(idx);
   354→    });
   355→
   356→    // Live findings (as they're discovered — incrementally builds the result)
   357→    socket.on("scan:finding", (event: { finding: Finding }) => {
   358→      liveFindingsRef.current.push(event.finding);
   359→    });
   360→
   361→    // Final result from the scanner service
   362→    socket.on("scan:complete", async (event: { result: ScanResult }) => {
   363→      const data = event.result;
   364→      setStage(SCAN_STAGES.length - 1); // COMPLETE
   365→      setResult(data);
   366→      setScanning(false);
   367→      liveFindingsRef.current = [];
   368→
   369→      if (!data.ok && data.errors.length > 0) {
   370→        toast.warning(data.errors[0]);
   371→      } else {
   372→        const n = data.findings.length;
   373→        if (n === 0) toast.success("Scan complete — site is clean");
   374→        else toast.success(`Scan complete — ${n} finding${n === 1 ? "" : "s"} exposed`);
   375→      }
   376→      setSessionHistory((h) => [data, ...h].slice(0, 8));
   377→
   378→      // Persist the result if the user is authenticated (use ref to avoid stale closure)
   379→      if (sessionRef.current?.user) {
   380→        try {
   381→          await fetch("/api/scans/save", {
   382→            method: "POST",
   383→            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
   384→            body: JSON.stringify(data),
   385→          });
   386→          refreshSaved();
   387→        } catch (err) {
   388→          console.warn("[scanner] failed to persist scan:", err);
   389→        }
   390→      }
   391→    });
   392→
   393→    socket.on("scan:error", (event: { error: string }) => {
   394→      setScanning(false);
   395→      toast.error(`Scan failed: ${event.error}`);
   396→    });
   397→
   398→    return () => {
   399→      socket.disconnect();
   400→      socketRef.current = null;
   401→    };
   402→  }, []);
   403→
   404→  async function runScan(e: React.FormEvent) {
   405→    e.preventDefault();
   406→    if (scanning) return;
   407→    const target = url.trim();
   408→    if (!target) {
   409→      toast.error("Enter a URL first");
   410→      return;
   411→    }
   412→    setScanning(true);
   413→    setResult(null);
   414→    setStage(0);
   415→    liveFindingsRef.current = [];
   416→
   417→    // If the WebSocket scanner-service is connected, use it (real-time progress).
   418→    // Otherwise, fall back to the legacy fetch POST to /api/scan.
   419→    if (socketRef.current?.connected) {
   420→      socketRef.current.emit("scan:start", { url: target });
   421→      return;
   422→    }
   423→
   424→    // Fallback: legacy fetch-based scan (no real-time progress)
   425→    const stageTimers: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>[] = [];
   426→    const intervals = [0, 2200, 6500, 11000, 15000, 19000];
   427→    for (let i = 1; i < SCAN_STAGES.length; i++) {
   428→      stageTimers.push(setTimeout(() => setStage(i), intervals[i]));
   429→    }
   430→
   431→    try {
   432→      const res = await fetch("/api/scan", {
   433→        method: "POST",
   434→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
   435→        body: JSON.stringify({ url: target }),
   436→      });
   437→      const data: ScanResult = await res.json();
   438→      for (const t of stageTimers) clearTimeout(t);
   439→      setStage(SCAN_STAGES.length - 1); // COMPLETE
   440→
   441→      setResult(data);
   442→      if (!data.ok && data.errors.length > 0) {
   443→        toast.warning(data.errors[0]);
   444→      } else {
   445→        const n = data.findings.length;
   446→        if (n === 0) toast.success("Scan complete — site is clean");
   447→        else toast.success(`Scan complete — ${n} finding${n === 1 ? "" : "s"} exposed`);
   448→      }
   449→      setSessionHistory((h) => [data, ...h].slice(0, 8));
   450→      if (session?.user) refreshSaved();
   451→    } catch (err) {
   452→      for (const t of stageTimers) clearTimeout(t);
   453→      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Network error";
   454→      toast.error(`Scan failed: ${msg}`);
   455→    } finally {
   456→      setScanning(false);
   457→    }
   458→  }
   459→
   460→  function exportJson() {
   461→    if (!result) return;
   462→    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
   463→    const url2 = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   464→    const a = document.createElement("a");
   465→    const safe = (result.targetUrl || "scan").replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, "_").slice(0, 60);
   466→    a.href = url2;
   467→    a.download = `leakguard-report-${safe}.json`;
   468→    a.click();
   469→    URL.revokeObjectURL(url2);
   470→    toast.success("Report exported");
   471→  }
   472→
   473→  function clearResults() {
   474→    setResult(null);
   475→    setStage(0);
   476→  }
   477→
   478→  async function clearSavedScans() {
   479→    try {
   480→      const res = await fetch("/api/scans", { method: "DELETE" });
   481→      const data = await res.json();
   482→      if (data.ok) {
   483→        setSavedScans([]);
   484→        toast.success("Saved scans cleared");
   485→      }
   486→    } catch {
   487→      toast.error("Failed to clear saved scans");
   488→    }
   489→  }
   490→
   491→  // -------- Layout: sidebar (desktop/tablet) + main, top bar (mobile) --------
   492→  return (
   493→    <div className="min-h-screen flex bg-transparent text-foreground relative">
   494→      {/* OriginKit Bokeh Particle Galaxy — full-screen WebGL2 background */}
   495→      <div className="fixed inset-0 -z-10 noise-overlay">
   496→        <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ pointerEvents: "auto" }}>
   497→          <BokehParticleGalaxy
   498→            background="#000000"
   499→            baseColor="#c81b1c"
   500→            accentColor="#ffffff"
   501→            scale={70}
   502→            speed={40}
   503→            advanced={{
   504→              eye: 5, haze: 12, lens: 35, seed: 0, spin: 12, wind: 140, grain: 0,
   505→              centerX: 50, centerY: 51, dotSize: 100, dustDim: 29, armNoise: 50,
   506→              dotDrift: 10, dustSize: 100, parallax: 4, vignette: 0,
   507→              bokehSize: 100, bokehSoft: 35, dotBright: 85, dustDrift: 30,
   508→              twinkleHz: 20, bokehCycle: 1400, dotDensity: 100, dustBright: 62,
   509→              armContrast: 60, bokehAspect: 160, bokehGrowth: 325,
   510→              dustDensity: 100, bokehOpacity: 100,
   511→            }}
   512→          />
   513→        </div>
   514→        <div className="absolute inset-0 scanline-overlay opacity-20 pointer-events-none" />
   515→      </div>
   516→
   517→      {/* View-transition wipe overlay + particle burst (fires when a sidebar nav item is clicked) */}
   518→      <AnimatePresence>
   519→        {viewTransitioning && (
   520→          <>
   521→            {/* Diagonal gradient wipe — cyan → violet → transparent, sweeping left → right */}
   522→            <motion.div
   523→              key="view-wipe"
   524→              initial={{ x: "-100%" }}
   525→              animate={{ x: "100%" }}
   526→              exit={{ x: "100%", opacity: 0 }}
   527→              transition={{ duration: 0.65, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
   528→              className="fixed inset-0 z-40 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden"
   529→            >
   530→              <div
   531→                className="absolute inset-0"
   532→                style={{
   533→                  background:
   534→                    "linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 0%, rgba(34,211,238,0.18) 30%, rgba(167,139,250,0.22) 50%, rgba(34,211,238,0.18) 70%, transparent 100%)",
   535→                }}
   536→              />
   537→              {/* Thin bright leading edge */}
   538→              <div
   539→                className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-px bg-white/80 shadow-[0_0_20px_4px_rgba(34,211,238,0.6)]"
   540→                style={{ left: "50%" }}
   541→              />
   542→              {/* Top + bottom edges */}
   543→              <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-cyan-300/80 to-transparent" />
   544→              <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-violet-300/80 to-transparent" />
   545→            </motion.div>
   546→
   547→            {/* Particle burst — 16 particles radiating from screen center */}
   548→            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
   549→              {Array.from({ length: 16 }).map((_, i) => {
   550→                const angle = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2;
   551→                const distance = 180 + (i % 4) * 80; // varied distances for depth
   552→                const dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
   553→                const dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
   554→                const color = i % 2 === 0 ? "#22d3ee" : "#a78bfa";
   555→                const size = 4 + (i % 3) * 2;
   556→                return (
   557→                  <motion.div
   558→                    key={i}
   559→                    initial={{ x: 0, y: 0, opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
   560→                    animate={{ x: dx, y: dy, opacity: 0, scale: 0.3 }}
   561→                    transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], delay: 0.05 }}
   562→                    className="rounded-full"
   563→                    style={{
   564→                      width: size,
   565→                      height: size,
   566→                      background: color,
   567→                      boxShadow: `0 0 ${size * 2}px ${color}`,
   568→                    }}
   569→                  />
   570→                );
   571→              })}
   572→              {/* Center flash */}
   573→              <motion.div
   574→                initial={{ scale: 0, opacity: 0.8 }}
   575→                animate={{ scale: 4, opacity: 0 }}
   576→                transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: "easeOut" }}
   577→                className="absolute w-8 h-8 rounded-full"
   578→                style={{
   579→                  background:
   580→                    "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.9), rgba(34,211,238,0.4) 50%, transparent 70%)",
   581→                }}
   582→              />
   583→            </div>
   584→          </>
   585→        )}
   586→      </AnimatePresence>
   587→
   588→      {/* ============ SIDEBAR (desktop + tablet) ============ */}
   589→      <aside className="hidden md:flex w-[72px] lg:w-[280px] shrink-0 sticky top-0 h-screen flex-col border-r border-white/5 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl">
   590→        <SidebarContent
   591→          clock={clock}
   592→          session={session}
   593→          activeSection={activeSection}
   594→          onNavClick={(id) => {
   595→            scrollToSection(id);
   596→            setMobileMenuOpen(false);
   597→          }}
   598→        />
   599→      </aside>
   600→
   601→      {/* Mobile top bar */}
   602→      <div className="md:hidden fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-white/5 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xl">
   603→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   604→          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg border border-cyan-400/40 bg-cyan-400/5 flex items-center justify-center">
   605→            <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
   606→          </div>
   607→          <h1 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">
   608→            <span className="text-white">LEAK</span>
   609→            <span className="text-cyan-300">GUARD</span>
   610→          </h1>
   611→        </div>
   612→        <button
   613→          onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
   614→          className="w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/5"
   615→        >
   616→          <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 transition ${mobileMenuOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
   617→        </button>
   618→      </div>
   619→
   620→      {/* Mobile dropdown menu */}
   621→      <AnimatePresence>
   622→        {mobileMenuOpen && (
   623→          <motion.div
   624→            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
   625→            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
   626→            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
   627→            className="md:hidden fixed top-[57px] left-0 right-0 z-20 border-b border-white/5 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-xl overflow-hidden"
   628→          >
   629→            <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
   630→              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70">
   631→                <span>UTC</span>
   632→                <span className="tabular-nums text-white/70">{clock}</span>
   633→              </div>
   634→              <AuthButton />
   635→            </div>
   636→          </motion.div>
   637→        )}
   638→      </AnimatePresence>
   639→
   640→      {/* ============ MAIN CONTENT ============ */}
   641→      {/* During a view transition, the main content zooms out (scale 0.97),
   642→          blurs (8px), and fades (0.55 opacity). When the transition ends,
   643→          it zooms back in + clears + re-opaques. Cinematic "page change" feel. */}
   644→      <motion.main
   645→        className="flex-1 min-w-0 relative origin-top"
   646→        animate={{
   647→          opacity: viewTransitioning ? 0.55 : 1,
   648→          scale: viewTransitioning ? 0.97 : 1,
   649→          filter: viewTransitioning ? "blur(8px)" : "blur(0px)",
   650→        }}
   651→        transition={{ duration: 0.45, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
   652→      >
   653→        {/* Top status strip (desktop only) */}
   654→        <div className="hidden md:block border-b border-white/5 bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-md">
   655→          <div className="pl-6 md:pl-8 lg:pl-10 xl:pl-12 pr-6 md:pr-10 lg:pr-16 xl:pr-20 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[10px] font-mono">
   656→            <div className="flex items-center gap-5 text-white/70">
   657→              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
   658→                <Crosshair className="w-3 h-3" />
   659→                TARGET: <span className="text-white/80">{result?.targetUrl ?? "—"}</span>
   660→              </span>
   661→              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
   662→                <Layers className="w-3 h-3" />
   663→                FINDINGS: <span className="text-white/80 tabular-nums">{result?.findings.length ?? 0}</span>
   664→              </span>
   665→              <span className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1.5">
   666→                <Signal className="w-3 h-3" />
   667→                STATUS: <span className="text-white/80">{scanning ? "SCANNING" : result ? "DONE" : "IDLE"}</span>
   668→              </span>
   669→            </div>
   670→            <div className="text-white/70">
   671→              {session?.user ? `OP: ${session.user.email}` : "GUEST MODE"}
   672→            </div>
   673→          </div>
   674→        </div>
   675→
   676→        <div className="pl-6 md:pl-8 lg:pl-10 xl:pl-12 pr-6 md:pr-10 lg:pr-16 xl:pr-20 py-10 md:py-16 pt-20 md:pt-16 w-full">
   677→          {/* ===== HERO ===== */}
   678→          <motion.section
   679→            id="target"
   680→            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.97 }}
   681→            whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
   682→            viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.1 }}
   683→            transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
   684→            className="mb-14 md:mb-20 scroll-mt-24"
   685→          >
   686→            <motion.div
   687→              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
   688→              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
   689→              transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
   690→              className="text-center mb-8"
   691→            >
   692→              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/5 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-mono mb-8 tracking-wider">
   693→                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse" />
   694→                BOUNDED · NO LOOPS · NO POLLING
   695→              </div>
   696→
   697→              {/* Quotation — Playfair Display italic + warm gold→coral→magenta gradient.
   698→                  Sits ABOVE the main headline. Uses a different font family (serif)
   699→                  and a unique color palette (warm) to contrast with the cool
   700→                  cyan/violet of the rest of the UI. */}
   701→              <motion.div
   702→                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
   703→                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
   704→                transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], delay: 0.15 }}
   705→                className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-center gap-4"
   706→              >
   707→                {/* Left decorative line */}
   708→                <span
   709→                  className="hidden sm:block h-px w-16"
   710→                  style={{
   711→                    background:
   712→                      "linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #fcd34d 50%, #fb7185)",
   713→                  }}
   714→                />
   715→                <p
   716→                  className="font-playfair text-gradient-quote text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl xl:text-5xl font-medium tracking-wide leading-snug"
   717→                  style={{ textShadow: "0 0 30px rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.25)" }}
   718→                >
   719→                  “Beyond The Limits”
   720→                </p>
   721→                {/* Right decorative line */}
   722→                <span
   723→                  className="hidden sm:block h-px w-16"
   724→                  style={{
   725→                    background:
   726→                      "linear-gradient(to left, transparent, #c084fc 50%, #f472b6)",
   727→                  }}
   728→                />
   729→              </motion.div>
   730→
   731→              <h1 className="text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl xl:text-8xl 2xl:text-9xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.02] mb-6">
   732→                <span className="text-white">Find every exposed</span>
   733→                <br />
   734→                <span className="text-gradient-cyan-violet">secret.</span>
   735→                <span className="text-white/80"> Before attackers do.</span>
   736→              </h1>
   737→              <p className="text-base md:text-lg text-white/80 max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
   738→                LeakGuard fetches the target, follows up to 20 scripts, probes 12 leak paths, and
   739→                surfaces API keys, source maps, and AI fingerprints — in a single bounded request.
   740→              </p>
   741→            </motion.div>
   742→
   743→            {/* URL input — premium glass */}
   744→            <motion.form
   745→              onSubmit={runScan}
   746→              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
   747→              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
   748→              transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.1 }}
   749→              className="glass-panel glass-panel-hover rounded-2xl p-2.5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2.5 max-w-3xl mx-auto"
   750→            >
   751→              <div className="relative flex-1">
   752→                <Search className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-5 h-5 text-white/70" />
   753→                <Input
   754→                  type="text"
   755→                  value={url}
   756→                  onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
   757→                  placeholder="https://example.com"
   758→                  className="pl-11 h-14 bg-transparent border-0 focus-visible:ring-0 font-mono text-base placeholder:text-white/60"
   759→                  disabled={scanning}
   760→                  autoComplete="off"
   761→                  spellCheck={false}
   762→                />
   763→              </div>
   764→              <Button
   765→                type="submit"
   766→                disabled={scanning}
   767→                className="h-14 px-8 bg-white hover:bg-white/90 text-black font-semibold tracking-tight shadow-[0_0_30px_-8px_rgba(255,255,255,0.4)]"
   768→              >
   769→                {scanning ? (
   770→                  <>
   771→                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
   772→                    Scanning
   773→                  </>
   774→                ) : (
   775→                  <>
   776→                    <Shield className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
   777→                    Execute Scan
   778→                  </>
   779→                )}
   780→              </Button>
   781→            </motion.form>
   782→
   783→            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70">
   784→              <span className="text-white/60">try:</span>
   785→              {["https://httpbin.org", "https://example.com"].map((t) => (
   786→                <button
   787→                  key={t}
   788→                  type="button"
   789→                  onClick={() => setUrl(t)}
   790→                  disabled={scanning}
   791→                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white/60 hover:text-cyan-300 hover:border-cyan-400/30 hover:bg-cyan-400/5 transition disabled:opacity-40"
   792→                >
   793→                  {t}
   794→                </button>
   795→              ))}
   796→            </div>
   797→          </motion.section>
   798→
   799→          {/* ===== SCANNING (animated 6-stage) ===== */}
   800→          <AnimatePresence>
   801→            {scanning && (
   802→              <motion.section
   803→                initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
   804→                animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
   805→                exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
   806→                className="mb-12 overflow-hidden"
   807→              >
   808→                <ScanProgress currentStage={stage} />
   809→              </motion.section>
   810→            )}
   811→          </AnimatePresence>
   812→
   813→          {/* ===== 3D VERIFICATION CONSTELLATION (centerpiece) ===== */}
   814→          <section id="verification" className="mb-14 md:mb-20 scroll-mt-24">
   815→            <motion.div
   816→              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
   817→              whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
   818→              viewport={{ once: true }}
   819→              transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
   820→              className="glass-panel rounded-2xl overflow-hidden"
   821→            >
   822→              <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
   823→                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
   824→                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/5 flex items-center justify-center">
   825→                    <Box className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
   826→                  </div>
   827→                  <div>
   828→                    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight">Verification Constellation</h3>
   829→                    <p className="text-[11px] text-white/70 font-mono">interactive · 3D · drag to orbit</p>
   830→                  </div>
   831→                </div>
   832→                <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70">
   833→                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse" />
   834→                  LIVE
   835→                </div>
   836→              </div>
   837→              <div className="relative h-[500px] sm:h-[600px] lg:h-[700px] xl:h-[800px]">
   838→                <ErrorBoundary>
   839→                  <LeakGuardScene />
   840→                </ErrorBoundary>
   841→              </div>
   842→              <div className="px-6 py-3 border-t border-white/5 text-center">
   843→                <p className="text-xs text-white/80 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
   844→                  Each orbiting model represents one leak category LeakGuard probes — a key for API
   845→                  keys, lock for secrets, fingerprint for AI-tool traces, document for exposed files,
   846→                  pyramid for source maps, avatar for PII, bug for debug routes, gear for misconfig.
   847→                </p>
   848→              </div>
   849→            </motion.div>
   850→          </section>
   851→
   852→          {/* ===== DETECTION MATRIX — interactive cards ===== */}
   853→          <motion.section
   854→            id="detection"
   855→            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.97 }}
   856→            whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
   857→            viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.15 }}
   858→            transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
   859→            className="mb-14 md:mb-20 scroll-mt-24"
   860→          >
   861→            <div className="flex items-end justify-between mb-6">
   862→              <div>
   863→                <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight">Detection Matrix</h2>
   864→                <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-white/80 mt-2">
   865→                  Eight leak categories scanned on every request.
   866→                </p>
   867→              </div>
   868→              <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70">
   869→                <Zap className="w-3 h-3" />
   870→                {DETECTION_CARDS.length} CATEGORIES
   871→              </div>
   872→            </div>
   873→
   874→            <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   875→              {DETECTION_CARDS.map((card, i) => (
   876→                <DetectionCard key={card.id} card={card} index={i} />
   877→              ))}
   878→            </div>
   879→          </motion.section>
   880→
   881→          {/* ===== SCAN RESULTS ===== */}
   882→          <motion.div
   883→            id="report"
   884→            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.97 }}
   885→            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
   886→            transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
   887→            className="scroll-mt-24 mb-14 md:mb-20"
   888→          >
   889→          {result && !scanning && (
   890→            <ResultDashboard result={result} onExport={exportJson} onClear={clearResults} />
   891→          )}
   892→          </motion.div>
   893→
   894→          {/* ===== DEBUGGING SOLUTIONS (only when findings > 0) ===== */}
   895→          {result && !scanning && result.findings.length > 0 && (
   896→            <DebuggingSolutions
   897→              result={result}
   898→              onRescan={() => {
   899→                // Re-use the URL from the last scan to trigger a new scan
   900→                if (result.targetUrl) {
   901→                  setUrl(result.targetUrl);
   902→                  // Use a small delay so the state updates before runScan reads it
   903→                  setTimeout(() => {
   904→                    const fakeEvent = { preventDefault: () => {} } as React.FormEvent;
   905→                    runScan(fakeEvent);
   906→                  }, 30);
   907→                }
   908→              }}
   909→            />
   910→          )}
   911→
   912→          {/* ===== SAVED SCANS (logged in) ===== */}
   913→          {session?.user && (
   914→            <motion.section
   915→              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.97 }}
   916→              whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
   917→              viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.15 }}
   918→              transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
   919→              className="mt-14"
   920→            >
   921→              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
   922→                <h3 className="text-base font-semibold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
   923→                  <Database className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
   924→                  Saved Scans <span className="text-white/70 text-sm">({savedScans.length})</span>
   925→                </h3>
   926→                {savedScans.length > 0 && (
   927→                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={clearSavedScans} className="text-xs text-white/80 hover:text-red-400">
   928→                    <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
   929→                    Clear all
   930→                  </Button>
   931→                )}
   932→              </div>
   933→              {loadingSaved ? (
   934→                <div className="text-xs font-mono text-white/70">Loading…</div>
   935→              ) : savedScans.length === 0 ? (
   936→                <div className="glass-panel rounded-xl p-5 text-center border-dashed border-white/10">
   937→                  <p className="text-xs text-white/80">
   938→                    No saved scans yet. Run a scan while logged in to persist it here.
   939→                  </p>
   940→                </div>
   941→              ) : (
   942→                <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
   943→                  {savedScans.slice(0, 9).map((s, i) => {
   944→                    const counts = severityCount(s.findings);
   945→                    return (
   946→                      <HistoryCard key={i} scan={s} counts={counts} onClick={() => {
   947→                        setResult(s);
   948→                        setStage(SCAN_STAGES.length - 1);
   949→                        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
   950→                      }} />
   951→                    );
   952→                  })}
   953→                </div>
   954→              )}
   955→            </motion.section>
   956→          )}
   957→
   958→          {/* ===== PROFILE (logged-in only — only the user can see their own PII) ===== */}
   959→          {session?.user && (
   960→            <ProfileSection
   961→              email={session.user.email ?? ""}
   962→              name={session.user.name ?? null}
   963→            />
   964→          )}
   965→
   966→          {/* ===== SESSION HISTORY ===== */}
   967→          {sessionHistory.length > 0 && !scanning && (
   968→            <motion.section
   969→              id="history"
   970→              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24, scale: 0.97 }}
   971→              whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
   972→              viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.15 }}
   973→              transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
   974→              className="mt-14 scroll-mt-24"
   975→            >
   976→              <h3 className="text-base font-semibold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
   977→                <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-violet-300" />
   978→                Session History <span className="text-white/70 text-sm">({sessionHistory.length})</span>
   979→              </h3>
   980→              <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   981→                {sessionHistory.map((h, i) => {
   982→                  const counts = severityCount(h.findings);
   983→                  return (
   984→                    <HistoryCard key={i} scan={h} counts={counts} onClick={() => {
   985→                      setResult(h);
   986→                      setStage(SCAN_STAGES.length - 1);
   987→                      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
   988→                    }} />
   989→                  );
   990→                })}
   991→              </div>
   992→            </motion.section>
   993→          )}
   994→        </div>
   995→
   996→        {/* Footer */}
   997→        <footer className="border-t border-white/5 bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-md mt-12">
   998→          <div className="px-6 py-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70">
   999→            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
  1000→              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse" />
  1001→              LEAKGUARD · BOUNDED SCANNER · NO POLLING · NO INFINITE LOOPS
  1002→            </span>
  1003→            <span>
  1004→              {session?.user ? `OPERATOR: ${session.user.email}` : "GUEST MODE — SCANS NOT PERSISTED"}
  1005→            </span>
  1006→          </div>
  1007→        </footer>
  1008→      </motion.main>
  1009→    </div>
  1010→  );
  1011→}
  1012→
  1013→// ============================================================================
  1014→// Sidebar content (shared by desktop + tablet)
  1015→// ============================================================================
  1016→function SidebarContent({
  1017→  clock,
  1018→  session,
  1019→  activeSection,
  1020→  onNavClick,
  1021→}: {
  1022→  clock: string;
  1023→  session: any;
  1024→  activeSection: string;
  1025→  onNavClick: (id: string) => void;
  1026→}) {
  1027→  return (
  1028→    <>
  1029→      {/* Logo */}
  1030→      <div className="px-4 lg:px-6 py-5 border-b border-white/5">
  1031→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
  1032→          <motion.div
  1033→            initial={{ rotate: -8, opacity: 0 }}
  1034→            animate={{ rotate: 0, opacity: 1 }}
  1035→            transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
  1036→            className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl border border-cyan-400/40 bg-cyan-400/5 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
  1037→          >
  1038→            <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-300" />
  1039→          </motion.div>
  1040→          <div className="hidden lg:block">
  1041→            <h1 className="text-base font-bold tracking-tight leading-none">
  1042→              <span className="text-white">LEAK</span>
  1043→              <span className="text-cyan-300">GUARD</span>
  1044→            </h1>
  1045→            <p className="text-[10px] text-white/70 mt-1.5 font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">
  1046→              AI Security Scanner
  1047→            </p>
  1048→          </div>
  1049→        </div>
  1050→      </div>
  1051→
  1052→      {/* Status block */}
  1053→      <div className="px-4 lg:px-6 py-4 border-b border-white/5 space-y-2">
  1054→        <StatusRow icon={Wifi} label="SYS" value="ONLINE" color="text-cyan-300" pulse />
  1055→        <StatusRow label="LOCAL" value={clock || "--:--:--"} mono />
  1056→        <StatusRow icon={Signal} label="CHN" value="STABLE" />
  1057→      </div>
  1058→
  1059→      {/* Nav */}
  1060→      <nav className="px-3 lg:px-3 py-4 flex-1 space-y-0.5">
  1061→        <p className="hidden lg:block text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-white/60 px-2 mb-2">
  1062→          Sections
  1063→        </p>
  1064→        {NAV_ITEMS.map((n) => {
  1065→          const active = activeSection === n.href;
  1066→          return (
  1067→            <button
  1068→              key={n.label}
  1069→              onClick={() => onNavClick(n.href)}
  1070→              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm transition group relative ${
  1071→                active
  1072→                  ? "bg-cyan-400/10 text-cyan-300"
  1073→                  : "text-white/60 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white"
  1074→              }`}
  1075→            >
  1076→              {active && (
  1077→                <motion.span
  1078→                  layoutId="activeNav"
  1079→                  className="absolute left-0 top-2 bottom-2 w-0.5 rounded-r bg-cyan-400"
  1080→                />
  1081→              )}
  1082→              <n.icon className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 ${active ? "text-cyan-300" : "text-white/70 group-hover:text-cyan-300"}`} />
  1083→              <span className="hidden lg:block flex-1 font-medium text-left">{n.label}</span>
  1084→              <ChevronRight className={`hidden lg:block w-3 h-3 transition ${active ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"}`} />
  1085→            </button>
  1086→          );
  1087→        })}
  1088→      </nav>
  1089→
  1090→      {/* Operator */}
  1091→      <div className="px-3 lg:px-3 py-3 border-t border-white/5">
  1092→        <p className="hidden lg:block text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-white/60 px-2 mb-2">
  1093→          Operator
  1094→        </p>
  1095→        <AuthButton />
  1096→      </div>
  1097→
  1098→      {/* Footer */}
  1099→      <div className="px-4 lg:px-6 py-3 border-t border-white/5 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/60 flex items-center justify-between">
  1100→        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
  1101→          <CircuitBoard className="w-3 h-3" />
  1102→          <span className="hidden lg:inline">v1.0</span>
  1103→        </span>
  1104→        <span className="hidden lg:inline">NO-LOOP</span>
  1105→      </div>
  1106→    </>
  1107→  );
  1108→}
  1109→
  1110→function StatusRow({
  1111→  icon: Icon,
  1112→  label,
  1113→  value,
  1114→  color = "text-white/70",
  1115→  mono = false,
  1116→  pulse = false,
  1117→}: {
  1118→  icon?: LucideIcon;
  1119→  label: string;
  1120→  value: string;
  1121→  color?: string;
  1122→  mono?: boolean;
  1123→  pulse?: boolean;
  1124→}) {
  1125→  return (
  1126→    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
  1127→      <span className="text-white/70 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
  1128→        {Icon && <Icon className="w-3 h-3" />}
  1129→        <span className="hidden lg:inline">{label}</span>
  1130→      </span>
  1131→      <span className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${color} ${mono ? "tabular-nums" : ""}`}>
  1132→        {pulse && <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse" />}
  1133→        {value}
  1134→      </span>
  1135→    </div>
  1136→  );
  1137→}
  1138→
  1139→// ============================================================================
  1140→// Detection card — interactive with hover glow + severity/status indicator
  1141→// ============================================================================
  1142→function DetectionCard({
  1143→  card,
  1144→  index,
  1145→}: {
  1146→  card: typeof DETECTION_CARDS[number];
  1147→  index: number;
  1148→}) {
  1149→  const accentColor = card.accent === "cyan" ? "#22d3ee" : "#a78bfa";
  1150→  return (
  1151→    <motion.div
  1152→      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
  1153→      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
  1154→      viewport={{ once: true }}
  1155→      transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: index * 0.05 }}
  1156→      className={`glass-panel glass-panel-hover rounded-xl p-4 cursor-default group ${card.accent === "violet" ? "glass-panel-violet" : ""}`}
  1157→    >
  1158→      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
  1159→        <div
  1160→          className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-center transition group-hover:scale-110"
  1161→          style={{
  1162→            borderColor: `${accentColor}40`,
  1163→            background: `${accentColor}10`,
  1164→          }}
  1165→        >
  1166→          <card.icon className="w-4 h-4" style={{ color: accentColor }} />
  1167→        </div>
  1168→        <div className="text-[9px] font-mono text-white/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/10">
  1169→          ACTIVE
  1170→        </div>
  1171→      </div>
  1172→      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1">{card.title}</h4>
  1173→      <p className="text-xs text-white/80 leading-snug mb-3">{card.description}</p>
  1174→      <div className="space-y-1.5">
  1175→        {card.examples.slice(0, 3).map((ex) => (
  1176→          <div key={ex} className="text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70 truncate flex items-center gap-1.5">
  1177→            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full" style={{ background: accentColor }} />
  1178→            {ex}
  1179→          </div>
  1180→        ))}
  1181→      </div>
  1182→      <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-white/5 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70 flex items-center justify-between">
  1183→        <span>coverage</span>
  1184→        <span style={{ color: accentColor }}>{card.coverage}</span>
  1185→      </div>
  1186→    </motion.div>
  1187→  );
  1188→}
  1189→
  1190→// ============================================================================
  1191→// Scan progress — 6-stage animated
  1192→// ============================================================================
  1193→function ScanProgress({ currentStage }: { currentStage: number }) {
  1194→  return (
  1195→    <div className="glass-panel rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8">
  1196→      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
  1197→        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/5 flex items-center justify-center animate-pulse-glow-cyan">
  1198→          <Radar className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-300" />
  1199→        </div>
  1200→        <div>
  1201→          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">Scan in progress</h3>
  1202→          <p className="text-xs text-white/80 font-mono">
  1203→            Stage {Math.min(currentStage + 1, SCAN_STAGES.length)} of {SCAN_STAGES.length} · bounded execution
  1204→          </p>
  1205→        </div>
  1206→      </div>
  1207→
  1208→      {/* Stage stepper */}
  1209→      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
  1210→        {SCAN_STAGES.map((s, i) => {
  1211→          const done = i < currentStage;
  1212→          const active = i === currentStage;
  1213→          const last = i === SCAN_STAGES.length - 1;
  1214→          const Icon = s.icon;
  1215→          const accentColor = s.accent === "cyan" ? "#22d3ee" : s.accent === "violet" ? "#a78bfa" : "#ffffff";
  1216→          return (
  1217→            <div key={s.id} className="flex items-center flex-1 min-w-0">
  1218→              <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 min-w-0 flex-1">
  1219→                <motion.div
  1220→                  initial={false}
  1221→                  animate={{
  1222→                    scale: active ? 1.15 : 1,
  1223→                    opacity: done || active ? 1 : 0.4,
  1224→                  }}
  1225→                  className="w-10 h-10 md:w-12 md:h-12 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-center transition relative"
  1226→                  style={{
  1227→                    borderColor: done || active ? `${accentColor}80` : "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
  1228→                    background: done || active ? `${accentColor}15` : "transparent",
  1229→                    boxShadow: active ? `0 0 30px -6px ${accentColor}80` : "none",
  1230→                  }}
  1231→                >
  1232→                  <Icon className="w-4 h-4 md:w-5 md:h-5" style={{ color: done || active ? accentColor : "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)" }} />
  1233→                  {active && (
  1234→                    <motion.div
  1235→                      className="absolute inset-0 rounded-xl border-2"
  1236→                      style={{ borderColor: accentColor }}
  1237→                      animate={{ opacity: [0.8, 0, 0.8], scale: [1, 1.25, 1] }}
  1238→                      transition={{ duration: 1.5, repeat: Infinity }}
  1239→                    />
  1240→                  )}
  1241→                </motion.div>
  1242→                <span
  1243→                  className="text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono tracking-wider text-center"
  1244→                  style={{ color: done || active ? accentColor : "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)" }}
  1245→                >
  1246→                  {s.label}
  1247→                </span>
  1248→              </div>
  1249→              {!last && (
  1250→                <div className="h-px flex-1 mx-2 relative overflow-hidden">
  1251→                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/10" />
  1252→                  <motion.div
  1253→                    initial={false}
  1254→                    animate={{ width: done ? "100%" : "0%" }}
  1255→                    transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
  1256→                    className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-cyan-400/60"
  1257→                  />
  1258→                </div>
  1259→              )}
  1260→            </div>
  1261→          );
  1262→        })}
  1263→      </div>
  1264→
  1265→      {/* Current stage detail */}
  1266→      <div className="glass-panel rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
  1267→        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300 animate-spin shrink-0" />
  1268→        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
  1269→          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-white/70">
  1270→            <span className="text-cyan-300">→</span> {SCAN_STAGES[Math.min(currentStage, SCAN_STAGES.length - 1)].label}
  1271→          </p>
  1272→          <p className="text-[11px] text-white/70 mt-0.5">
  1273→            {currentStage === 0 && "Validating target URL against http(s) protocol and length limits."}
  1274→            {currentStage === 1 && "Downloading HTML with 15s timeout and 1.5MB cap."}
  1275→            {currentStage === 2 && "Running regex matchers across HTML and inline scripts."}
  1276→            {currentStage === 3 && "Fetching up to 20 <script> sources, 10s each, 600KB cap."}
  1277→            {currentStage === 4 && "Detecting AI-tool fingerprints in meta tags, comments, and JS."}
  1278→            {currentStage === 5 && "Aggregating findings and ranking by severity."}
  1279→          </p>
  1280→        </div>
  1281→        <span className="animate-blink text-cyan-300 font-mono">▌</span>
  1282→      </div>
  1283→    </div>
  1284→  );
  1285→}
  1286→
  1287→// ============================================================================
  1288→// Profile section — private view of operator's own account info.
  1289→// This is the ONLY place in the website where the user's email/name is
  1290→// rendered. The sidebar chip hides all PII.
  1291→// ============================================================================
  1292→type ProfileData = {
  1293→  ok: boolean;
  1294→  profile?: {
  1295→    email: string;
  1296→    name: string | null;
  1297→    createdAt: string;
  1298→    scanCount: number;
  1299→    lastScan: {
  1300→      targetUrl: string;
  1301→      createdAt: string;
  1302→      findingCount: number;
  1303→      criticalCount: number;
  1304→      highCount: number;
  1305→    } | null;
  1306→  };
  1307→  error?: string;
  1308→};
  1309→
  1310→function ProfileSection({ email, name }: { email: string; name: string | null }) {
  1311→  const [data, setData] = useState<ProfileData | null>(null);
  1312→  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  1313→  const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0);
  1314→
  1315→  useEffect(() => {
  1316→    let mounted = true;
  1317→    setLoading(true);
  1318→    (async () => {
  1319→      try {
  1320→        const res = await fetch("/api/profile", { method: "GET", cache: "no-store" });
  1321→        const json = await res.json();
  1322→        if (mounted) setData(json);
  1323→      } catch {
  1324→        if (mounted) setData({ ok: false, error: "Failed to load profile" });
  1325→      } finally {
  1326→        if (mounted) setLoading(false);
  1327→      }
  1328→    })();
  1329→    return () => { mounted = false; };
  1330→  }, [email, reloadKey]);
  1331→
  1332→  // Avatar initials from email or name
  1333→  const initials = useMemo(() => {
  1334→    const src = name || email || "?";
  1335→    const parts = src.split(/[\s@.]+/).filter(Boolean);
  1336→    if (parts.length === 0) return "?";
  1337→    if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  1338→    return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
  1339→  }, [email, name]);
  1340→
  1341→  const displayName = name || email.split("@")[0];
  1342→  const hasError = data && !data.ok;
  1343→  const profile = data?.profile;
  1344→  const memberSince = profile?.createdAt
  1345→    ? new Date(profile.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
  1346→        year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric",
  1347→      })
  1348→    : "—";
  1349→  const scanCount = profile?.scanCount ?? 0;
  1350→  const lastScan = profile?.lastScan;
  1351→
  1352→  return (
  1353→    <motion.section
  1354→      id="profile"
  1355→      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
  1356→      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
  1357→      viewport={{ once: true }}
  1358→      transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
  1359→      className="mt-14 scroll-mt-24"
  1360→    >
  1361→      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
  1362→        <h3 className="text-base font-semibold tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
  1363→          <UserIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
  1364→          Operator Profile
  1365→        </h3>
  1366→        <Badge className="text-[10px] font-mono bg-cyan-400/15 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-400/30">
  1367→          PRIVATE
  1368→        </Badge>
  1369→      </div>
  1370→
  1371→      <div className="glass-panel rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
  1372→        {/* Header band with avatar + identity */}
  1373→        <div className="relative p-6 md:p-8 border-b border-white/5 bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-400/5 via-transparent to-violet-400/5">
  1374→          <div className="absolute top-3 right-4 text-[9px] font-mono text-white/60 tracking-wider">
  1375→            VISIBLE ONLY TO YOU
  1376→          </div>
  1377→          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start gap-5">
  1378→            {/* Avatar */}
  1379→            <div className="relative">
  1380→              <motion.div
  1381→                initial={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0 }}
  1382→                whileInView={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
  1383→                viewport={{ once: true }}
  1384→                transition={{ duration: 0.4, type: "spring" }}
  1385→                className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl border border-cyan-400/40 bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-400/20 to-violet-400/20 flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_30px_-8px_rgba(34,211,238,0.4)]"
  1386→              >
  1387→                <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">{initials}</span>
  1388→              </motion.div>
  1389→              <div className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 border-2 border-background flex items-center justify-center">
  1390→                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 text-black" />
  1391→              </div>
  1392→            </div>
  1393→
  1394→            {/* Identity */}
  1395→            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
  1396→              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300 mb-1">
  1397→                AUTHENTICATED OPERATOR
  1398→              </div>
  1399→              <h4 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-1 truncate">{displayName}</h4>
  1400→              {loading ? (
  1401→                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-white/70">
  1402→                  <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
  1403→                  Loading profile…
  1404→                </div>
  1405→              ) : hasError ? (
  1406→                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
  1407→                  <span className="text-red-400 font-mono">Failed to load</span>
  1408→                  <button
  1409→                    onClick={() => setReloadKey(k => k + 1)}
  1410→                    className="text-cyan-300 hover:text-cyan-200 underline font-mono"
  1411→                  >
  1412→                    retry
  1413→                  </button>
  1414→                </div>
  1415→              ) : (
  1416→                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-white/60 font-mono">
  1417→                  <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white/70" />
  1418→                  <span className="truncate">{email}</span>
  1419→                </div>
  1420→              )}
  1421→              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-white/70 font-mono mt-2">
  1422→                <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
  1423→                Member since {loading ? "…" : memberSince}
  1424→              </div>
  1425→            </div>
  1426→          </div>
  1427→        </div>
  1428→
  1429→        {/* Stats grid */}
  1430→        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 p-6 md:p-8">
  1431→          <ProfileStatCard
  1432→            label="Total Scans"
  1433→            value={loading ? "—" : String(scanCount)}
  1434→            icon={Activity}
  1435→            accent="cyan"
  1436→          />
  1437→          <ProfileStatCard
  1438→            label="Critical Found"
  1439→            value={loading ? "—" : String(lastScan?.criticalCount ?? 0)}
  1440→            icon={AlertTriangle}
  1441→            accent="red"
  1442→          />
  1443→          <ProfileStatCard
  1444→            label="High Found"
  1445→            value={loading ? "—" : String(lastScan?.highCount ?? 0)}
  1446→            icon={ShieldAlert}
  1447→            accent="orange"
  1448→          />
  1449→        </div>
  1450→
  1451→        {/* Last scan summary */}
  1452→        {lastScan && (
  1453→          <div className="px-6 md:px-8 pb-6 md:pb-8">
  1454→            <div className="glass-panel rounded-xl p-4 border-cyan-400/20">
  1455→              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
  1456→                <Activity className="w-3 h-3" />
  1457→                Last Scan
  1458→              </div>
  1459→              <p className="text-sm font-mono text-white/80 break-all mb-1">{lastScan.targetUrl}</p>
  1460→              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70">
  1461→                <span>{new Date(lastScan.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
  1462→                <span>·</span>
  1463→                <span>{lastScan.findingCount} findings</span>
  1464→                {lastScan.criticalCount > 0 && (
  1465→                  <>
  1466→                    <span>·</span>
  1467→                    <span className="text-red-400">{lastScan.criticalCount} crit</span>
  1468→                  </>
  1469→                )}
  1470→                {lastScan.highCount > 0 && (
  1471→                  <>
  1472→                    <span>·</span>
  1473→                    <span className="text-orange-400">{lastScan.highCount} high</span>
  1474→                  </>
  1475→                )}
  1476→              </div>
  1477→            </div>
  1478→          </div>
  1479→        )}
  1480→
  1481→        {/* === TRUST SLOGANS === */}
  1482→        <div className="px-6 md:px-8 pb-6 md:pb-8">
  1483→          <div className="rounded-xl border border-cyan-400/20 bg-cyan-400/[0.03] p-5">
  1484→            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
  1485→              <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
  1486→              <h5 className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300">
  1487→                Trust & Security
  1488→              </h5>
  1489→            </div>
  1490→            <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
  1491→              {TRUST_SLOGANS.map((s, i) => (
  1492→                <motion.div
  1493→                  key={s.title}
  1494→                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
  1495→                  whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
  1496→                  viewport={{ once: true }}
  1497→                  transition={{ duration: 0.3, delay: i * 0.06 }}
  1498→                  className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/5 hover:border-cyan-400/20 transition group"
  1499→                >
  1500→                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/5 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 group-hover:scale-110 transition">
  1501→                    <s.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-300" />
  1502→                  </div>
  1503→                  <div className="min-w-0">
  1504→                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/90 mb-0.5">{s.title}</p>
  1505→                    <p className="text-[11px] text-white/80 leading-snug">{s.desc}</p>
  1506→                  </div>
  1507→                </motion.div>
  1508→              ))}
  1509→            </div>
  1510→          </div>
  1511→        </div>
  1512→
  1513→        {/* Action footer */}
  1514→        <div className="px-6 md:px-8 py-4 border-t border-white/5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
  1515→          <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70 max-w-md">
  1516→            Your email and name are only visible here — never exposed elsewhere in the website.
  1517→          </p>
  1518→          <Button
  1519→            variant="ghost"
  1520→            size="sm"
  1521→            onClick={() => signOut({ redirect: false })}
  1522→            className="text-white/60 hover:text-red-300 hover:bg-red-400/5 font-mono"
  1523→          >
  1524→            <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
  1525→            Sign out
  1526→          </Button>
  1527→        </div>
  1528→      </div>
  1529→    </motion.section>
  1530→  );
  1531→}
  1532→
  1533→function ProfileStatCard({
  1534→  label,
  1535→  value,
  1536→  icon: Icon,
  1537→  accent,
  1538→}: {
  1539→  label: string;
  1540→  value: string;
  1541→  icon: LucideIcon;
  1542→  accent: "cyan" | "red" | "orange";
  1543→}) {
  1544→  const accentMap = {
  1545→    cyan: { hex: "#22d3ee", tailwind: "text-cyan-300" },
  1546→    red: { hex: "#ef4444", tailwind: "text-red-400" },
  1547→    orange: { hex: "#f97316", tailwind: "text-orange-400" },
  1548→  };
  1549→  const a = accentMap[accent];
  1550→  return (
  1551→    <div className="glass-panel rounded-xl p-4 relative overflow-hidden">
  1552→      <div
  1553→        className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-20 h-20 rounded-full blur-3xl opacity-15"
  1554→        style={{ background: a.hex }}
  1555→      />
  1556→      <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between">
  1557→        <div>
  1558→          <p className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-white/70">{label}</p>
  1559→          <p className={`text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums mt-1 ${a.tailwind}`}>{value}</p>
  1560→        </div>
  1561→        <Icon className="w-4 h-4 opacity-50" style={{ color: a.hex }} />
  1562→      </div>
  1563→    </div>
  1564→  );
  1565→}
  1566→
  1567→// ============================================================================
  1568→// Debugging solutions section — appears after scan results when findings > 0
  1569→// ============================================================================
  1570→function DebuggingSolutions({
  1571→  result,
  1572→  onRescan,
  1573→}: {
  1574→  result: ScanResult;
  1575→  onRescan: () => void;
  1576→}) {
  1577→  const findings = result.findings;
  1578→  const total = findings.length;
  1579→  if (total === 0) return null;
  1580→
  1581→  // Group findings by category to know which solutions are relevant
  1582→  const findingsByCategory: Record<string, number> = {};
  1583→  for (const f of findings) {
  1584→    findingsByCategory[f.category] = (findingsByCategory[f.category] ?? 0) + 1;
  1585→  }
  1586→
  1587→  // Filter + sort solutions: only show categories that have findings, sorted by priority
  1588→  const relevantSolutions = DEBUGGING_SOLUTIONS
  1589→    .filter((s) => findingsByCategory[s.category])
  1590→    .sort((a, b) => SOLUTION_PRIORITY_RANK[a.priority] - SOLUTION_PRIORITY_RANK[b.priority]);
  1591→
  1592→  const priorityColor: Record<DebugSolution["priority"], string> = {
  1593→    critical: "#ef4444",
  1594→    high: "#f97316",
  1595→    medium: "#f59e0b",
  1596→    low: "#0ea5e9",
  1597→  };
  1598→
  1599→  return (
  1600→    <motion.section
  1601→      id="solutions"
  1602→      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24 }}
  1603→      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
  1604→      viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.1 }}
  1605→      transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
  1606→      className="mt-14 scroll-mt-24"
  1607→    >
  1608→      {/* Header */}
  1609→      <div className="flex items-end justify-between mb-4 flex-wrap gap-3">
  1610→        <div>
  1611→          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
  1612→            <Wrench className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
  1613→            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300">
  1614→              POST-SCAN REMEDIATION
  1615→            </span>
  1616→          </div>
  1617→          <h3 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">
  1618→            Debugging Solutions
  1619→          </h3>
  1620→          <p className="text-sm text-white/80 mt-1 max-w-xl">
  1621→            Step-by-step action plan for the {total} {total === 1 ? "finding" : "findings"} exposed in this scan. Start with critical issues.
  1622→          </p>
  1623→        </div>
  1624→        <Button
  1625→          onClick={onRescan}
  1626→          className="bg-white/5 hover:bg-cyan-400/10 text-white hover:text-cyan-300 border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-400/40 font-medium"
  1627→        >
  1628→          <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
  1629→          Re-scan target
  1630→        </Button>
  1631→      </div>
  1632→
  1633→      {/* Priority action banner */}
  1634→      {relevantSolutions.some(s => s.priority === "critical") && (
  1635→        <Alert className="mb-4 border-red-500/40 bg-red-500/5">
  1636→          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400" />
  1637→          <AlertTitle className="text-red-400 font-semibold text-sm">
  1638→            Critical action required
  1639→          </AlertTitle>
  1640→          <AlertDescription className="text-sm text-white/60">
  1641→            This scan exposed critical-severity leaks. Rotate the affected keys/secrets at their provider BEFORE deploying any other fixes — assume they are already in attacker hands.
  1642→          </AlertDescription>
  1643→        </Alert>
  1644→      )}
  1645→
  1646→      {/* Per-category solution cards */}
  1647→      <div className="space-y-4">
  1648→        {relevantSolutions.map((sol, i) => {
  1649→          const count = findingsByCategory[sol.category];
  1650→          const color = priorityColor[sol.priority];
  1651→          const meta = CATEGORY_META[sol.category];
  1652→          return (
  1653→            <motion.div
  1654→              key={sol.category}
  1655→              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
  1656→              whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
  1657→              viewport={{ once: true, amount: 0.2 }}
  1658→              transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: i * 0.05 }}
  1659→            >
  1660→              <div className="glass-panel rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
  1661→                {/* Card header */}
  1662→                <div
  1663→                  className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-white/5 flex items-start gap-3"
  1664→                  style={{ borderLeft: `3px solid ${color}` }}
  1665→                >
  1666→                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
  1667→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 flex-wrap">
  1668→                      <span
  1669→                        className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded"
  1670→                        style={{ background: `${color}20`, color, border: `1px solid ${color}50` }}
  1671→                      >
  1672→                        {sol.priority}
  1673→                      </span>
  1674→                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70">
  1675→                        {meta?.label ?? sol.category} · {count} {count === 1 ? "finding" : "findings"}
  1676→                      </span>
  1677→                    </div>
  1678→                    <h4 className="text-base font-semibold tracking-tight text-white/90">
  1679→                      {sol.title}
  1680→                    </h4>
  1681→                    <p className="text-xs text-white/80 mt-1 leading-relaxed">{sol.summary}</p>
  1682→                  </div>
  1683→                </div>
  1684→
  1685→                {/* Steps list */}
  1686→                <div className="p-5">
  1687→                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
  1688→                    <ListChecks className="w-3 h-3" />
  1689→                    Action Plan
  1690→                  </div>
  1691→                  <ol className="space-y-2.5">
  1692→                    {sol.steps.map((step, idx) => (
  1693→                      <li key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-3 text-sm">
  1694→                        <span
  1695→                          className="shrink-0 w-6 h-6 rounded-md border flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-mono font-medium"
  1696→                          style={{
  1697→                            background: `${color}15`,
  1698→                            borderColor: `${color}40`,
  1699→                            color,
  1700→                          }}
  1701→                        >
  1702→                          {String(idx + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
  1703→                        </span>
  1704→                        <span className="text-white/70 leading-relaxed pt-0.5">{step}</span>
  1705→                      </li>
  1706→                    ))}
  1707→                  </ol>
  1708→
  1709→                  {/* Tools links */}
  1710→                  {sol.tools && sol.tools.length > 0 && (
  1711→                    <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-white/5">
  1712→                      <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-white/70 mb-2">
  1713→                        Tools & Resources
  1714→                      </div>
  1715→                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  1716→                        {sol.tools.map((t) => (
  1717→                          <a
  1718→                            key={t.url}
  1719→                            href={t.url}
  1720→                            target="_blank"
  1721→                            rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"
  1722→                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-xs text-white/70 hover:text-cyan-300 hover:border-cyan-400/30 hover:bg-cyan-400/5 transition"
  1723→                          >
  1724→                            <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
  1725→                            {t.name}
  1726→                          </a>
  1727→                        ))}
  1728→                      </div>
  1729→                    </div>
  1730→                  )}
  1731→                </div>
  1732→              </div>
  1733→            </motion.div>
  1734→          );
  1735→        })}
  1736→      </div>
  1737→
  1738→      {/* Verification checklist */}
  1739→      <div className="mt-6 glass-panel rounded-2xl p-5 border-cyan-400/20">
  1740→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
  1741→          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
  1742→          <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-cyan-300">
  1743→            Verification checklist
  1744→          </h4>
  1745→        </div>
  1746→        <p className="text-xs text-white/80 mb-4 leading-relaxed">
  1747→          After applying the fixes above, run through this checklist before re-scanning to confirm everything is in place.
  1748→        </p>
  1749→        <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
  1750→          {[
  1751→            "All leaked keys revoked at their provider's console",
  1752→            "New keys stored only in server-side env vars",
  1753→            "Web server returns 404 for /.env, /.git/, /package.json",
  1754→            "Source maps (.js.map) return 404 on production",
  1755→            "console.log stripped from production bundle",
  1756→            "process.env.* no longer appears in shipped JS",
  1757→            "AI-generator meta tags + comments stripped",
  1758→            "Hardcoded PII moved to server-rendered partials",
  1759→          ].map((check) => (
  1760→            <div
  1761→              key={check}
  1762→              className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-white/60 p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/5"
  1763→            >
  1764→              <span className="shrink-0 w-4 h-4 rounded border border-white/20 mt-0.5" />
  1765→              <span className="leading-snug">{check}</span>
  1766→            </div>
  1767→          ))}
  1768→        </div>
  1769→        <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
  1770→          <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70">
  1771→            Re-scan after applying fixes to verify — should show 0 findings.
  1772→          </p>
  1773→          <Button
  1774→            onClick={onRescan}
  1775→            size="sm"
  1776→            className="bg-white hover:bg-white/90 text-black font-semibold"
  1777→          >
  1778→            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
  1779→            Re-scan now
  1780→          </Button>
  1781→        </div>
  1782→      </div>
  1783→    </motion.section>
  1784→  );
  1785→}
  1786→
  1787→// ============================================================================
  1788→// Result dashboard — premium glass + expandable findings
  1789→// ============================================================================
  1790→function ResultDashboard({
  1791→  result,
  1792→  onExport,
  1793→  onClear,
  1794→}: {
  1795→  result: ScanResult;
  1796→  onExport: () => void;
  1797→  onClear: () => void;
  1798→}) {
  1799→  const counts = severityCount(result.findings);
  1800→  const total = result.findings.length;
  1801→
  1802→  const grouped: Record<string, Finding[]> = {};
  1803→  for (const f of result.findings) {
  1804→    if (!grouped[f.category]) grouped[f.category] = [];
  1805→    grouped[f.category].push(f);
  1806→  }
  1807→
  1808→  const severities: (keyof typeof counts)[] = ["critical", "high", "medium", "low", "info"];
  1809→  const sevColors: Record<string, string> = {
  1810→    critical: "bg-red-500",
  1811→    high: "bg-orange-500",
  1812→    medium: "bg-amber-500",
  1813→    low: "bg-yellow-400",
  1814→    info: "bg-sky-500",
  1815→  };
  1816→  const sevHex: Record<string, string> = {
