  1817→    critical: "#ef4444",
  1818→    high: "#f97316",
  1819→    medium: "#f59e0b",
  1820→    low: "#facc15",
  1821→    info: "#0ea5e9",
  1822→  };
  1823→
  1824→  return (
  1825→    <motion.section
  1826→      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
  1827→      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
  1828→      transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
  1829→      className="mb-12"
  1830→    >
  1831→      {/* Header */}
  1832→      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between gap-3 mb-6">
  1833→        <div>
  1834→          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
  1835→            <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
  1836→            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-300">SCAN REPORT</span>
  1837→          </div>
  1838→          <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight">
  1839→            {total === 0 ? "Target is clean" : `${total} ${total === 1 ? "finding" : "findings"} exposed`}
  1840→          </h2>
  1841→          <p className="text-sm text-white/80 mt-1 font-mono break-all">{result.targetUrl}</p>
  1842→        </div>
  1843→        <div className="flex gap-2">
  1844→          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onExport} disabled={total === 0}
  1845→            className="border-white/10 text-white/70 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-cyan-300 hover:border-cyan-400/30">
  1846→            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
  1847→            Export JSON
  1848→          </Button>
  1849→          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClear} className="text-white/80 hover:text-white">
  1850→            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
  1851→            Clear
  1852→          </Button>
  1853→        </div>
  1854→      </div>
  1855→
  1856→      {/* Severity breakdown bar */}
  1857→      {total > 0 && (
  1858→        <div className="mb-4">
  1859→          <div className="flex h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-white/5">
  1860→            {severities.map((s) =>
  1861→              counts[s] > 0 ? (
  1862→                <motion.div
  1863→                  key={s}
  1864→                  className={`${sevColors[s]}`}
  1865→                  initial={{ width: 0 }}
  1866→                  animate={{ width: `${(counts[s] / total) * 100}%` }}
  1867→                  transition={{ duration: 0.6, delay: 0.1 }}
  1868→                />
  1869→              ) : null
  1870→            )}
  1871→          </div>
  1872→        </div>
  1873→      )}
  1874→
  1875→      {/* Premium stat cards */}
  1876→      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3 mb-6">
  1877→        <PremiumStat
  1878→          label="Total"
  1879→          value={total}
  1880→          icon={Layers}
  1881→          accent="white"
  1882→        />
  1883→        <PremiumStat
  1884→          label="Critical"
  1885→          value={counts.critical}
  1886→          icon={AlertTriangle}
  1887→          accent="red"
  1888→        />
  1889→        <PremiumStat
  1890→          label="High"
  1891→          value={counts.high}
  1892→          icon={ShieldAlert}
  1893→          accent="orange"
  1894→        />
  1895→        <PremiumStat
  1896→          label="Medium"
  1897→          value={counts.medium}
  1898→          icon={AlertTriangle}
  1899→          accent="amber"
  1900→        />
  1901→        <PremiumStat
  1902→          label="Low / Info"
  1903→          value={counts.low + counts.info}
  1904→          icon={CheckCircle2}
  1905→          accent="sky"
  1906→        />
  1907→      </div>
  1908→
  1909→      {/* Meta */}
  1910→      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 mb-6">
  1911→        <MetaCard label="Duration" value={`${(result.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`} />
  1912→        <MetaCard label="HTML Bytes" value={result.fetchedBytes.toLocaleString()} />
  1913→        <MetaCard label="Scripts" value={`${result.scriptCount}`} />
  1914→        <MetaCard label="Path Probes" value={`${result.fileProbeCount}`} />
  1915→      </div>
  1916→
  1917→      {/* Errors */}
  1918→      {result.errors.length > 0 && (
  1919→        <Alert className="mb-6 border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/5">
  1920→          <Bug className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
  1921→          <AlertTitle className="text-amber-400 font-mono text-xs">SCAN WARNINGS</AlertTitle>
  1922→          <AlertDescription className="font-mono text-xs">
  1923→            <ul className="list-disc pl-5 space-y-0.5 mt-1">
  1924→              {result.errors.map((e, i) => (
  1925→                <li key={i}>{e}</li>
  1926→              ))}
  1927→            </ul>
  1928→          </AlertDescription>
  1929→        </Alert>
  1930→      )}
  1931→
  1932→      {/* Findings */}
  1933→      {total === 0 ? (
  1934→        <Alert className="border-cyan-400/40 bg-cyan-400/5">
  1935→          <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-300" />
  1936→          <AlertTitle className="text-cyan-300 font-semibold">No leaks detected</AlertTitle>
  1937→          <AlertDescription className="text-sm text-white/60">
  1938→            None of LeakGuard&apos;s pattern matchers or path probes returned a positive result.
  1939→            Note: this is not a full security audit — only the well-known AI-tool leak patterns are checked.
  1940→          </AlertDescription>
  1941→        </Alert>
  1942→      ) : (
  1943→        <Tabs defaultValue="all" className="mt-2">
  1944→          <TabsList className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-lg p-1 h-auto flex-wrap justify-start overflow-x-auto">
  1945→            <TabsTrigger value="all" className="text-xs data-[state=active]:bg-cyan-400/15 data-[state=active]:text-cyan-300">
  1946→              All ({total})
  1947→            </TabsTrigger>
  1948→            {Object.entries(grouped).map(([cat, list]) => (
  1949→              <TabsTrigger
  1950→                key={cat}
  1951→                value={cat}
  1952→                className="text-xs data-[state=active]:bg-cyan-400/15 data-[state=active]:text-cyan-300"
  1953→              >
  1954→                {CATEGORY_META[cat as keyof typeof CATEGORY_META]?.label ?? cat} ({list.length})
  1955→              </TabsTrigger>
  1956→            ))}
  1957→          </TabsList>
  1958→
  1959→          <TabsContent value="all" className="mt-4 space-y-2">
  1960→            {result.findings.map((f, i) => (
  1961→              <FindingRow key={f.id} finding={f} index={i} sevHex={sevHex} />
  1962→            ))}
  1963→          </TabsContent>
  1964→
  1965→          {Object.entries(grouped).map(([cat, list]) => (
  1966→            <TabsContent key={cat} value={cat} className="mt-4 space-y-2">
  1967→              <p className="text-xs text-white/80 mb-3 border-l-2 border-cyan-400/40 pl-3">
  1968→                {CATEGORY_META[cat as keyof typeof CATEGORY_META]?.description}
  1969→              </p>
  1970→              {list.map((f, i) => (
  1971→                <FindingRow key={f.id} finding={f} index={i} sevHex={sevHex} />
  1972→              ))}
  1973→            </TabsContent>
  1974→          ))}
  1975→        </Tabs>
  1976→      )}
  1977→    </motion.section>
  1978→  );
  1979→}
  1980→
  1981→// ============================================================================
  1982→// Premium stat card — glass + accent + icon
  1983→// ============================================================================
  1984→function PremiumStat({
  1985→  label,
  1986→  value,
  1987→  icon: Icon,
  1988→  accent,
